race.comment: COURTHEZON (8) closed strongly on debut as the ($1.85 fav) with an encouraging second in the small field over 1300m at Goulburn. Well placed on the better track. HIGH GRADE (2) Maurice gelding from Archanna on debut for the Messara and Gavranich stable. Had his third trial this time in and the blinkers and cross-over nose band go on. Look for him closing strongly. JOSAIN (12) showed good early speed on debut before tiring late in the soft (7) conditions to run fourth over 1200m at this track. Can improve further. FAWLTY AFFAIRS (9) blinkers come off for this after he resumed with a disappointing last over 1100m at Hawkesbury. Deserves another chance in this weaker contest.
